name: Izobel Termiya
source:
Isobel. Daughter of [url=https://vndb.org/c152948]Artemis[/url], goddess of the hunt. Has had great strength since birth. Never lost battles before [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url]. She didn't solve anything in the cult, only taking orders from her mother. In her entire life, she's seen just toughness. And when I treated her kindly it melted her heart. And she doesn't even care that I took away her eyesight. She's afraid I won't trust her.

[In game description]
